Dear support team,

Hopeful stretch so far, and the departures lead mentioned a detail about animal welfare, so I want everyone aligned before the next wave of handoffs. Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk notes tight, practical, and focused on comfort checks, carrier condition, and calm loading. If a traveler arrives with a pet that seems stressed, slow the pace and loop in the safety coordinator right away. <<FACT F001>> Use the same steady approach when you review lounge access, and keep any concern visible in the shared log.

For the next batch, watch the pet relief routing closely and confirm that ground staff are using the correct path without rushing. <<FACT F016>> If you see a mismatch between the booking notes and the station setup, flag it immediately and keep the traveler informed in simple language. The goal is to avoid confusion at the gate and reduce last-minute corrections. Also, when you speak with crews, remind them that safety takes priority over speed in every journey, and that small checks now prevent bigger issues later. Keep the tone calm, clear, and helpful.

Please keep this moving with steady attention and report anything unusual before release.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
